# cloudsmith_team (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright Cloudsmith Ltd 2026
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

provider "cloudsmith" {
  api_key = "my-api-key"
}

data "cloudsmith_organization" "my_org" {
  slug = "my-organization"
}

resource "cloudsmith_team" "my_team" {
  organization = data.cloudsmith_organization.my_org.slug_perm
  name         = "My Team"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) A descriptive name for the team.
- `organization` (String) Organization to which this team belongs.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of the team's purpose.
- `slug` (String) The slug identifies the team in URIs.
- `visibility` (String) Controls if the team is visible or hidden from non-members.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `slug_perm` (String) The slug_perm immutably identifies the team. It will never change once a team has been created.
